faqs.q: Is local SEO different from regular SEO in Greece?
faqs.a: Yes. Local SEO wins the map pack and Greek-language local searches; generic SEO chases broad traffic that rarely converts for local businesses. In Greece's seasonal economy, timing matters too: the two disciplines need different calendars.

faqs.q: Can I do SEO for my Greek business myself?
faqs.a: The basics are manageable: claim your profile, gather reviews, keep information accurate in Greek. The technical work, Greek keyword research, and seasonal content planning are where a specialist earns their keep.

faqs.q: Why is my competitor outranking me in Greece?
faqs.a: Usually stronger Greek-language relevance, more reviews, or better seasonal preparation. I audit all three and show you which gap is actually costing you customers, so we fix the right thing first.

faqs.q: Do I need a Google Business Profile in Greece?
faqs.a: Yes, it is free and decisive for local searches. Tourists rely on it heavily: reviews, photos, and accurate hours in both Greek and English will win you bookings that a website alone cannot.
